title: CAT 2023 Question Paper (Slot 1, PYQ) - Quantitative Aptitude - Number System
subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.q: Let $n$ be the least positive integer such that $168$ is a factor of $1134^n$. If $m$ is the least positive integer such that $1134^n$ is a factor of $168^m$, then $m+n$ equals
questions.explain:
Prime factorizations: $168 = 2^3 \times 3 \times 7$ and $1134 = 2 \times 3^4 \times 7$. 
First, $168 | 1134^n \implies 2^3 \times 3 \times 7 | 2^n \times 3^{4n} \times 7^n$. For this to be true, the powers of 2 must satisfy $n \ge 3$. Thus, the least positive integer $n$ is $3$.
Next, $1134^3 | 168^m \implies (2 \times 3^4 \times 7)^3 | (2^3 \times 3 \times 7)^m \implies 2^3 \times 3^{12} \times 7^3 | 2^{3m} \times 3^m \times 7^m$. For the powers of 3 to hold, $m \ge 12$. Thus, the least positive integer $m$ is $12$.
The sum $m + n = 12 + 3 = 15$.
